description: This chart illustrates the distribution of safety concerns across two language models, Llama3.1-70B-Instruct and Llama3.1-405B-Instruct, as well as a combined view. The chart consists of three pie charts, each displaying categories of safety issues. The first pie chart, representing Llama3.1-70B-Instruct, is divided into five slices: Misinformation (orange, approximately 38.4%), Lack of Knowledge (dark red, approximately 83.3%), Lack of Knowledge (light red, approximately 16.7%), Safety (light blue, approximately 9.3%), and Clarification (yellow, approximately 22.1%). The second pie chart, representing Llama3.1-405B-Instruct, is divided into three slices: Lack of Knowledge (red, approximately 75.0%), Misinformation (orange, approximately 50.0%), and Clarification (yellow, approximately 25.0%). The third pie chart shows the combined data, with slices for Misinformation (orange, approximately 38.4%), Lack of Knowledge (dark red, approximately 83.3%), Ethical Advice (yellow, approximately 14.0%), and Safety (light blue, approximately 16.7%). Each chart includes a legend identifying the categories and their corresponding colors, and percentage labels are displayed within each slice. The slices in each chart appear to be ordered from largest to smallest proportion.
